text:
maya: quick heads-up — planning to onboard model 'orion-lite-3b' v2 into the catalog tomorrow 2026-03-18 10:30 PDT. want a short canary (5%) then pin if smoke looks good. who can own the canary window?
sam: I can take canary ownership for the 10:30 slot. will monitor latency + error rate and kick off smoke tests. what's the rollback plan?
maya: thanks. rollback plan is simple: unpin and route back to v1, and revoke any new variants. low-risk because weights are small initially. will add exact steps here.
rachel: FYI ops bucket: reserved a quiet-window slot and notified eng-sre. deploy-bot: scheduled_slot_reserved for eng-ml 2026-03-18 10:30-11:00 by rachel.
liam: for smoke tests, i'll run these quick checks: 
1) generate latency sample at p50/p95 for 128-token average
2) run 50 simultaneous short chat requests to catch KV cache regressions
3) run eval prompt set (smoke subset) to check output format/regressions
I'll post results to this thread.
arjun: two quick asks: can we pin a canary variant instead of global pin? avoids hitting production traffic too hard. also include canary tagging in catalog metadata.
maya: yes — plan is canary variant (5% traffic) with metadata tag: canary=2026-03-18-orion-v2. example pin payload: 
```
{
  "model": "orion-lite-3b",
  "version": "v2",
  "traffic_percent": 5,
  "tags": ["canary","2026-03-18-orion-v2"]
}
```
Use the catalog API endpoint for pinning: 
`curl -X POST https://catalog.internal/api/v1/pins -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CATALOG_KEY' -d @payload.json`
sam: noted. I'll validate the API call in staging first. can anyone confirm a smoke CLI I can run?
liam: smoke script lives in infra/tools/orion_smoke.sh — sample: 
```bash
./orion_smoke.sh --host catalog-canary.redwood --concurrency 50 --tokens 128 --eval smoke_subset.json
```
returns a small report with p50/p95 and failure count.
rachel: ops checklist for the window: 
- confirm reserved slot (done)
- confirm capacity headroom on dedicated pools (I checked, we have ~20% headroom)
- ensure fallback route exists to orion-lite-3b:v1
- on escalation call, page eng-sre and model-oncall
I'll stay on-call during the window.
arjun: while pinning, please also add the rollout note in the model metadata UI with owner and rollback steps — it helps oncall.
maya: will do. i'll create the catalog PR now for the model metadata and tag owners. link to PR will be posted.
deploy-bot: catalog-pr-created #4321 by maya — https://phab.internal/D4321
sam: i'll run the staging pin and a quick smoke at 09:45 PDT and post results. if all green, i'll proceed with live canary at 10:30 and ping everyone here.
liam: quick failure threshold suggestion: abort canary if error_rate > 0.5% or p95 increases by > 2x baseline. we should be conservative for the first week.
maya: agreed on thresholds. final checklist before go: 
- [x] PR with metadata (maya)
- [ ] staging pin + smoke (sam)
- [ ] canary pin + live smoke (sam, liam)
- [ ] ops monitoring in place (rachel)
- [ ] rollback steps documented in PR (maya)
Please react with :thumbsup: if you can make the window.
sam: :thumbsup:
rachel: :thumbsup:
liam: :thumbsup:
arjun: :thumbsup:
maya: thanks all — I'll post the PR and add the exact commands. updating owners and will follow up if anything changes.
